title: Trumpeter Irving Randolph
summary: Trumpeter Irving Randolph of St. Louis joins in 1928 and later goes to Cab Calloway.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: There was another guy named Irving Ervin Randolph from St. Louis. Irving Ervin Randolph -- I don't know where he was born, but we met him here in St. Louis. He joined our band back in '28.
Beautiful trumpet player. Cab Calloway took him too. Now, I don't know where he is now, see. I'm just giving you a taste of the caliber of musicians that we had at that time.
